#!/usr/bin/env python3
import http.server
import json
import sqlite3
import os
import re

DATA_DIR = "/var/lib/failover"
DB_PATH = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "records.sqlite3")
ROLE_FILE = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "replica.role")
UPSTREAM_FILE = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "upstream")

class FailoverHandler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        pass  # Suppress logging

    def read_role(self):
        try:
            with open(ROLE_FILE, "r") as f:
                return f.read().strip()
        except:
            return ""

    def db_conn(self):
        conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
        conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT)")
        conn.commit()
        return conn

    def do_GET(self):
        role = self.read_role()
        if self.path == "/health":
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b"ready")
        elif self.path == "/role":
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(role.encode("utf-8"))
        elif self.path.startswith("/records/"):
            if role != "primary":
                self.send_response(503)
                self.end_headers()
                return
            rec_id = self.path[9:]  # strip "/records/"
            conn = self.db_conn()
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT body FROM records WHERE id=?", (rec_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            conn.close()
            if row:
                self.send_response(200)
                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
                self.end_headers()
                self.wfile.write(row[0].encode("utf-8"))
            else:
                self.send_response(404)
                self.end_headers()
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

    def do_PUT(self):
        role = self.read_role()
        if role != "primary":
            self.send_response(503)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        if self.path.startswith("/records/"):
            rec_id = self.path[9:]
            content_length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
            body = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            conn = self.db_conn()
            conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO records (id, body) VALUES (?, ?)", (rec_id, body.decode("utf-8")))
            conn.commit()
            conn.close()
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8080), FailoverHandler)
    print("Starting failover service on 127.0.0.1:8080")
    server.serve_forever()
